page.content:
2006 sale of Pixar to Disney.

How Disney acquisition connects

  • Topic: Pixar — The 2006 acquisition made Pixar a Disney studio.
  • Faction: The Walt Disney Company — Disney bought Pixar in 2006.
  • Character: Steve Jobs — Jobs sold Pixar to Disney and joined Disney's board.

What is Disney acquisition?

The Disney acquisition in 2006 made Pixar a wholly owned Disney studio, with Jobs becoming Disney's largest individual shareholder and Catmull taking a wider animation brief.

Key threads lead to Pixar, The Walt Disney Company and Steve Jobs.
